title: Finite time blowup for an averaged three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equation
venue: Journal of the American Mathematical Society 29(3):601-674
annotation: Replaces the bilinear term of the Navier-Stokes equations by an averaged operator that keeps the energy identity, and proves finite-time blowup for the modified equation; the result does not transfer to the original equations.

title: Finite time blowup for Navier-Stokes
annotation: Claims that a smooth, compactly supported force and zero initial velocity give a three-dimensional Navier-Stokes solution with bounded energy whose velocity becomes unbounded in finite time, the forced alternatives of the Clay statement; under evaluation.
